annotations.title: Name and define campaign result metrics

description: Name and define the numbers campaign_profit shows. action list (default): every metric key the brand uploaded with upload_campaign_results (with its label and kind) and every formula, the built-in ones (cac_percent, cost_per_sale, cost_per_qualified_lead, lead_to_sale, qualified_rate) and the brand's own. action set: key plus label, kind (count, money, percent or ratio), currency (for money) and/or formula, a calculation with + - * / and parentheses over spend, impressions, clicks, sales, revenue, leads, qualified_leads, profit and any uploaded metric key, e.g. "(revenue - spend) / clicks"; formula null removes it. action remove: key. Every formula is shown per campaign in campaign_profit; a division by zero or a number a campaign does not have shows as empty, never 0. Which conversion events count as campaign results is set_profit_settings resultEvents. Free.

action.description: default list (set when key is given)
